title: Cafe Society with Red Allen, New Year's 1940
summary: Hammond talked Red Allen into hiring him; the airline hesitated and the band was fired from Cafe Society.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So how did John Hammond - I guess he got to Red Allen and got to know you and Red Allen from your playing during the 30's, and then did he form the band for Red?

He talked Red into hiring me. When you got money, you can do a lot of things. He told Red, "Why don't you send for Higgy?" So Red said O.K. John Hammond sent me a plane ticket and $50. It took me 3 days to get on there. They didn't want no negros on the plane. So John Hammond said, "You don't put him on there we're going to sue you."
Where did you join Red Allen?
And how long did you stay there?
Oh, I don't know how long we stayed down there. We stayed down there till they fired us. He told Red Allen if he didn't get rid of somebody he was going to fire the whole band.
I came here in '45 and you and Red were playing at the Onyx Club.
Yeah, we went from Downtown up to the Onyx Club.
So in other words, from '40 to almost '45 he was at the Cafe Society?
Yeah, we left Cafe Society and went to 52nd Street.
